we have identified 32 genes expressed early on the dorsal side of the zebrafish embryo that have the potential of modulating Wnt signaling.

we have identified 32 new genes expressed on the dorsal side of early embryos that are transcribed after the onset of the zygotic transcription and that we have shown that a large fraction of these genes are involved in modulation of canonical Wnt signaling.

the molecular interactions that underlie the formation of the dorsal body axis in zebrafish embryos

a large proportion of the early dorsal expressed genes are involved in the regulation of the canonical WNT pathway.
